start: Plans page, gym online, owner signed in

user_sees: Title 'Plans', 'What you sell, and for how much', button '+ Add plan', one row per plan in the gym's order
must_not: Plans of another gym or branch
A retired plan looking the same as one for sale

steps.action: Tap '+ Add plan', type 'Plan name' Quarterly, 'Duration' 3 with 'Unit' months, 'Price (₹)' 3000, 'Joining fee (₹)' 500, save
user_sees: Sheet 'Add plan' with 'Charged once, on a member’s first plan.' under the joining fee
The sheet closes and the plan is at the end of the list
must_not: Price saved as 30 or 300000 (rupees and paise mixed up)
The plan saved twice
The joining fee charged on a renewal

steps.action: Open Members, sell a membership, look at the plan choices
user_sees: The new plan with its price and joining fee
must_not: The new plan missing from the sell sheet
A plan not for sale offered

start: Plans page with an existing plan (second entry: the edit sheet)

steps.action: Tap the plan row's edit button
user_sees: Sheet 'Edit plan' filled with the plan's name, duration, price, joining fee, description and 'For sale?'
must_not: Price shown in paise
A PT plan opening with the PT switch off

steps.action: Change the price from 3000 to 3500, save
user_sees: The new price on the row; a line that a new price is used only for new sales
must_not: Dues of members already on this plan changed
Old receipts or old memberships re-priced

start: Plans page, another kind: a PT plan

steps.action: Tap '+ Add plan', switch 'PT plan' on, type 'PT sessions' 12 and 'Trainer (optional)', save
user_sees: 'How many sessions this plan includes.'; the plan row shows it is PT with 12 sessions
must_not: A PT plan saved with 0 sessions
The trainer name kept after PT is switched off

steps.action: Leave the name empty (or one letter), save
user_sees: 'Give the plan a name.' under the name box
must_not: A plan with no name

user_sees: 'Duration must be a whole number between 1 and 120.'
must_not: 1e2 saved as 100 months

steps.action: Leave the price empty or type letters; type letters in the joining fee
user_sees: 'The price looks wrong. Type it again.' / 'The joining fee looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: A plan saved with no price
A negative price

steps.action: Type the name of a plan that already exists, save
user_sees: Either a refusal, or two rows that can be told apart
must_not: Two plans with the same name and no way to tell which is sold

steps.action: On the empty page tap 'Use a starter price list' twice fast
user_sees: Button shows 'Adding…' and cannot be pressed again; five plans appear once; on a failure: '… Some plans may already be added. Check the list.'
must_not: Ten plans with duplicate names

start: Plans page, a plan members are on

steps.action: Open 'Edit plan', switch 'For sale?' off, save
user_sees: The plan stays in the list marked not for sale; members already on it keep it
must_not: The plan deleted
Members on it losing their membership or dues
The plan still offered when selling

user_sees: The plan is offered again, with the same price
must_not: A second copy of the plan

start: Plans page, signed in as front desk

user_sees: The same price list, with no '+ Add plan' and no edit button on any row
must_not: An add or edit button for staff
Prices hidden from the desk that sells them

steps.action: Sell a membership to a member from the list
user_sees: The plans for sale at their listed price; staff may give at most 10% off and must charge the joining fee as listed
must_not: Staff selling at a made-up price
A plan that is not one of the gym's plans

start: Plans page with no plans, signed in as front desk

user_sees: 'No plans yet' and 'Ask your gym owner to add the plans you sell.'; no buttons
must_not: 'Use a starter price list' offered to staff
A save that the server refuses after staff filled a sheet

start: Plans page open on the desk while the owner edits

steps.action: Owner changes a price and retires a plan on another device; staff refreshes
user_sees: The new price and the retired mark on the desk's list
must_not: The desk selling at the old price after the refresh
The retired plan still offered
